game: Resident Evil Revelations 2 (2015), Complete PC Route
target: Spoiler-free total completion: both campaign routes, every record and reward, all Raid missions and medallions, Deluxe content, and verified Switch exclusives

areas.name: Route and Edition Setup
areas.location_cue: Steam's DLC manager, the title menu, and the Raid Mode vestibule.
areas.note: The Windows Complete Season is primary; Deluxe add-ons and the verified Switch-only branch are audited separately.

levels.1: Begin with the episodic campaign and Raid content installed together.
levels.2: Install the Windows game, all four main episodes, both extra episodes, and every owned update.
levels.3: Open Steam's DLC manager, enable the campaign episodes and both extra episodes, finish the update, then launch Campaign and Raid Mode once so their local data is created.

levels.1: The most complete PC route adds maps, characters, costumes, and storage.
levels.2: Enable the Throwback pack, both Raid characters, four costumes, and all nine storage expansions.
levels.3: In Steam's DLC manager, tick every Deluxe component, relaunch, then confirm Gauntlet IX, two extra character slots, four costume entries, and expanded weapon, part, and album capacities can register.

levels.1: Several choices alter later routes even though scenarios remain replayable.
levels.2: Back up the new local profile before Episode 1 and again before the Episode 3 choice.
levels.3: Close the game before copying its local save through your normal backup method. Restore-test the copy on a spare location, then keep dated backups before Episode 3's final input and Episode 4's route lever.

levels.1: No owned gameplay footage exists for this title yet.
levels.2: Use the physical text cues; this pack intentionally contains no sketches or screenshots.
levels.3: Do not generate substitute art or import another guide's images. Add visuals later only when they can be harvested from Sami's own recording with recorded provenance.

areas.name: Extra Episodes
areas.location_cue: The two separately listed bonus episodes beneath the main campaign menu.
areas.note: Both add-on episodes support Casual and Survival; their special records remain outside the main record-set total.

levels.1: Hunt efficiently during supply stages so the survival stages remain recoverable.
levels.2: Complete The Struggle Casual by meeting clear Casual route.
levels.3: Start The Struggle on Casual, collect food before each gate, preserve ammunition for wave stages, and satisfy clear Casual route. Let the final result save before replaying.

levels.1: Hunt efficiently during supply stages so the survival stages remain recoverable.
levels.2: Complete The Struggle Survival by meeting clear Survival route.
levels.3: Start The Struggle on Survival, collect food before each gate, preserve ammunition for wave stages, and satisfy clear Survival route. Let the final result save before replaying.

levels.1: Hunt efficiently during supply stages so the survival stages remain recoverable.

levels.3: Start The Struggle on Survival, collect food before each gate, preserve ammunition for wave stages, and satisfy Survival S rank. Let the final result save before replaying.

levels.1: Hunt efficiently during supply stages so the survival stages remain recoverable.
levels.2: Complete The Struggle Full Rations by meeting fill complete ration gauge.
levels.3: During the first scavenging stage, hunt animals until the ration meter is full; if needed, deliberately retry while retaining gathered food minus the spent continue. Reach the gate with the gauge completely filled.

levels.1: Study patrols with the unseen partner before moving the vulnerable character.
levels.2: Complete Little Miss Casual by meeting clear Casual route.
levels.3: Start Little Miss on Casual, use cover and limited smoke bottles to cross each patrol route, and satisfy clear Casual route before the final postcard registers.

levels.1: Study patrols with the unseen partner before moving the vulnerable character.
levels.2: Complete Little Miss Survival by meeting clear Survival route.
levels.3: Start Little Miss on Survival, use cover and limited smoke bottles to cross each patrol route, and satisfy clear Survival route before the final postcard registers.

levels.1: Study patrols with the unseen partner before moving the vulnerable character.

levels.1: Study patrols with the unseen partner before moving the vulnerable character.
levels.2: Complete Little Miss Unseen by meeting never get detected.
levels.3: Complete every Little Miss stage without allowing an enemy detection state. Scout routes first, remain crouched behind cover, use smoke only at forced crossings, and restart any stage as soon as detection occurs.

levels.1: Study patrols with the unseen partner before moving the vulnerable character.
levels.2: Complete Little Miss No Pointing by meeting never use partner pointing.
levels.3: Complete every Little Miss stage without using the partner's pointing command. You may switch viewpoints to study patrols, but never mark an enemy; restart the stage immediately if a marker is placed.

areas.name: Raid Weapon Catalog
areas.location_cue: Mission chests, unidentified albums, the jukebox, store, and weapon storage.
areas.note: The AK-7 has no verified named rare counterpart; the other base weapons list their named variants separately.

levels.1: Evaluate weapon albums from mission chests and watch the store rotation.
levels.2: Obtain the base MPM at any level or tag.
levels.3: Open every chest during Raid clears, evaluate weapon albums at the jukebox, and inspect the store between missions until MPM appears. Keep one copy long enough for the weapon-catalog record to update.

areas.name: Raid Gauntlet I
areas.location_cue: The Raid stage-select panel headed Gauntlet I, with its difficulty tabs and mission tiles.
areas.note: Every mission has five separate medallions; Completion requires the preceding four during one run.

levels.1: Reach the goal once under any valid result.
levels.2: Finish Gauntlet I, Normal, Mission 1 and touch its goal marker.
levels.3: Select Gauntlet I, Normal, Mission 1, defeat or bypass enemies as the objective permits, complete any required switch or defense task, then use the goal marker and confirm the Clear medallion lights on results.

levels.1: The stage compares your selected level with its recommendation.
levels.2: Clear Gauntlet I, Normal, Mission 1 at or below its displayed recommended level.
levels.3: Before launching Gauntlet I, Normal, Mission 1, use the level-adjust command to set the character no higher than the displayed recommendation. Finish the mission and confirm the Challenge medallion on results.

items.label: Gauntlet I Normal Mission 1, No Herb

levels.1: Plan a safe route and leave manual healing unused.
levels.2: Clear Gauntlet I, Normal, Mission 1 without consuming any herb.
levels.3: Enter Gauntlet I, Normal, Mission 1 with a defensive build, avoid opening the herb command, and restart if an herb is consumed. Reach the goal and verify the No Herb medallion is awarded.

levels.1: Search every branch before ending the mission.
levels.2: Defeat every enemy spawned in Gauntlet I, Normal, Mission 1 before using the goal.
levels.3: Sweep every room and optional branch in Gauntlet I, Normal, Mission 1, wait for delayed waves, and check the remaining-enemy display where available. Use the goal only after every spawned target is defeated.

levels.1: The final medallion demands every other condition during one clear.
levels.2: Earn all four other medallions together in one run of Gauntlet I, Normal, Mission 1.
levels.3: Set your level at or below the recommendation, consume no herbs, defeat every spawned enemy, and reach the goal in the same uninterrupted run of Gauntlet I, Normal, Mission 1. Confirm all five medallions illuminate together.
